title: Project State
description: Schema for project state tracked by the Project War Room skill. Each project maintains a single state object persisted at /projects/{name}/STATE.md.

project_id.description: Unique identifier for the project, typically a slug derived from the project name.

repo_path.description: Absolute filesystem path to the project's git repository root.

health_grade.description: Letter grade derived from health_score. A (80-100), B (60-79), C (40-59), D (20-39), F (0-19).

last_scored.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent health score computation.

git_activity.description: Git repository activity metrics used for the Git Activity dimension (25 pts).

commits_7d.description: Number of commits to the default branch in the last 7 days.

commits_30d.description: Number of commits to the default branch in the last 30 days.

open_prs.description: Number of currently open pull requests.

merged_prs_7d.description: Number of pull requests merged in the last 7 days.

stale_branches.description: Number of branches with no commits in the last 14 days.

last_commit_date.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent commit on the default branch.

active_contributors.description: Number of unique contributors with commits in the last 7 days.

deployment.description: Deployment pipeline metrics used for the Deployment Health dimension (20 pts).

last_deploy_date.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent deployment. Null if never deployed.

last_deploy_status.description: Outcome of the most recent deployment.

deploy_count_30d.description: Total number of deployments in the last 30 days.

rollback_count_30d.description: Number of rollbacks in the last 30 days.

issues.description: Issue tracker metrics used for the Issue Health dimension (20 pts).

open_count.description: Total number of currently open issues.

bug_count.description: Number of open issues labeled as bugs.

feature_count.description: Number of open issues labeled as features or enhancements.

avg_age_days.description: Average age in days of all open issues.

oldest_unresolved_days.description: Age in days of the oldest unresolved issue.

blockers.description: Blocker tracking metrics used for the Blocker Status dimension (20 pts).

active_count.description: Number of currently active blockers for this project.

blocked_by.description: List of project IDs that are currently blocking this project.

blocking.description: List of project IDs that this project is currently blocking.

avg_blocker_age_days.description: Average age in days of all active blockers.

velocity.description: Velocity and throughput metrics used for decision engine ranking.

tasks_completed_7d.description: Number of tasks (issues closed, PRs merged) completed in the last 7 days.

tasks_completed_30d.description: Number of tasks completed in the last 30 days.

velocity_trend.description: Direction of velocity change. Computed by comparing 7-day rate to 30-day rolling average.

story_points_7d.description: Total story points completed in the last 7 days. Zero if story points are not tracked.

dependencies.description: Cross-project dependencies detected by the dependency mapper.

status.description: Current status of the dependency relationship.

alerts.description: Active and recent alerts generated by the monitoring system.

level.description: Severity level of the alert, corresponding to health score thresholds.

message.description: Human-readable alert message describing the condition.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the alert was generated.

metadata.description: Bookkeeping metadata for the state object.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this state object was first created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent update to any field.

scored_by.description: Identifier of the agent or process that last computed the health score.
